clues.question: What are the three stages of thunderstorm lifecycle? List their characteristics

What is the difference between a CTAF and a UNICOM?
clues.answer: A CTAF (Common Traffic Advisory Frequency) is a designated radio frequency used by pilots to self-announce their positions and intentions to other aircraft at a non-towered airport, while a UNICOM station is a non-government ground communication facility (often run by a local Fixed-Base Operator) that may share that frequency to provide advisory airport information and services
